edits.before: W-bounce the trades — the heal-damage bounce wins every honest level 1 exchange.
edits.after: Zilean needs two bombs to stun and is defenseless between them — your poke runs free.

edits.before: Bubble threats begin: the lane's longest stun re-prices their every step-up.
edits.after: Hitting 2 first with E-buffed autos plus Bubble beats his slow double-bomb setup.

edits.before: Full kit: E the carry's autos and the buffed trade window out-damages their plan.
edits.after: At 3 Bubble punishes his bomb cooldown and your poke out-trades his setup.

edits.before: Tide the margins: bounce the trades, bubble the answers, and bank the tempo passive.
edits.after: Your heal-buffed poke keeps chipping his low base defenses through levels 4-5.

edits.before: First item: the bounce chunks and the bubble converts every gank.
edits.after: First item: Bubble beats his sidestep-able double-bomb stun.

edits.before: Late Nami conducts: wave the engage, bubble the peel, and E whoever's swinging.
edits.after: Into items Bubble outclasses his double-bomb, and your R punishes his positioning.

edits.before: - Zilean Chronoshift: matchup-defining — The revive undoes your kill — force it early or swap focus when it glows. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your Q Aqua Prison answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Zilean R (Chronoshift): 120/90/60s CD — the revive undoes your kill, so force it early or swap focus once it glows before every duo step-up. - His Q (Time Bomb) needs a second bomb to stun, on a 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s CD — punish the gap between bombs.

edits.before: W the bounce through carry-and-support, E your carry, auto — the trade healed you, billed them, and buffed the follow-up.
edits.after: His single Time Bomb carries no stun — E-buff your carry and trade through it before a second bomb lands nearby.

edits.before: Throwing the bubble at poke range out of boredom — the stun is the matchup; the rest is salad.
edits.after: Standing near a stuck Time Bomb waiting to see if it pops — a second bomb detonating it stuns you.
